## review follow-ups of PR #33775 (card #33658)

Record: 6893056455 (at-tier PASS on head `6072b2db`, nits only).

- [ ] Stale eval prose (raised by the developer, confirmed by the review): `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` id 7 `expected_output` still says a refusal catalogue on a hook without a `js` body is refused at save. False since PR #33641 (#33214): a handler hook may declare `refusals`. The assertions still agree with the skill; only the prose clause is wrong. One-clause fix.
- [ ] nit `data-hooks.md`: "a reason missing from a code's `reasons`" is silent on a code that declares no `reasons` (a thrown `reason` is then not read and the code's own sentence is served).
- [ ] nit `data-hooks.md`: "at save if thrown literally" holds for a `js` body and an inline handler, not for a named (string) handler, whose source the save cannot read (met as the 500 the sentence's second half names).

`skills/objectstack-data/**`; `'@objectstack/skills': patch`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #33775.
